beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then read the constitution of resilience alongside the dark side of fragmentation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The full scenarios help readers compare choices without assuming their preferred scale stays benevolent.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book’s promise is a more careful account of where governing functions belong.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to judge which failures should remain local and which responsibilities must still be shared.
